issue.title: Remote attention inventory poll reads only the first page per host; next_cursor is never followed
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1aq.10.7.5.5 (note #1, 2026-09-27) during the sase-xe ancestor landing; originally sase-168 follow-up 1 and sase-xe.16.11.7 note #5, whose owning epics are now closed.

Reproduced by reading master 19abe261d4: `_poll_fleet_attention_inventory` (src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_remote_attention.py:268) calls `fetch_remote_attention_inventory(cache_only=...)` with no `cursor`, so each poll reads only the first page (`_INBOX_PAGE_LIMIT`) per host. `fetch_remote_attention_inventory` (src/sase/dispatch/attention_inbox.py:~99) already accepts `cursor`, and the gateway returns `page.has_more` / `page.next_cursor`, but nothing follows them. The only mitigation is `_payload_is_fresh_complete` (attention_inbox.py:465), which refuses to settle absences when `has_more`/`next_cursor` is set. That stops wrong auto-dismissals but never mirrors rows past page one.

Fix: follow `next_cursor` per host until `has_more` is false, or up to a bounded page budget, before reconciling. Check whether the federated inventory read can carry a per-host cursor, or whether that needs a sase-core federation change.

task_type_fields.impact: Hosts with more than one page of actionable attention rows are only partly mirrored into the viewer's durable inbox. Attention items past page one never raise notifications on the controller.
